title: Shadowrealm Casinos and Lottery: How In-Game Gambling Works
subtitle: Eight casino games per city, player-owned tables and a weekly jackpot, explained.
description: How in-game gambling works in Shadowrealm: casino games in every city, roulette bets, player-owned tables and the weekly lottery, plus a sensible way to play.
card: Casinos, roulette, player-owned tables and the weekly lottery in Shadowrealm: Age of Darkness, with a sensible way to gamble in-game gold.

faq.q: Is gambling in Shadowrealm real money?
faq.a: No. Casino games and the lottery are played with in-game gold. Shadowgems are a separate optional currency for the Gem Shop, sold as one-time purchases, and nothing here pays out real money.

faq.q: Can players own casinos in Shadowrealm?
faq.a: Yes. Every table except Poker can be bought by a player, who then banks the house edge on bets placed there. Ownership needs rank 2 in Ashenvale, 4 in Shadowmere, 6 in Duskholm or 8 in The Dark Citadel.

faq.q: How does the Shadowrealm lottery work?
faq.a: The draw is weekly. The jackpot is a base amount plus a contribution from every ticket sold, one player wins it all, and an empty round rolls the jackpot over. A small tax is taken from the payout.
